sys_atf_test.description: Tests the fully connected procurement chain end-to-end. Creates a supplier, then creates just an order, receipt, and quality check — and validates that the entire downstream chain fires automatically: (1) order total_amount is auto-calculated by calc-order-total BR (15*200=3000), (2) order status auto-updates to delivered by update-order-on-receipt BR, (3) receipt status auto-updates to passed with quantity_accepted=190 and quantity_rejected=0 by update-receipt-from-qc BR, (4) procurement report is auto-generated by auto-generate-report BR with calculated quality_score, delivery_score, quantity_accuracy all greater than zero and status=submitted. Cleans up all records including the auto-generated report.
sys_atf_test.name: Connected Chain End-to-End Test
